# Compiler-reference property controls

These sources are synthetic, local-only and non-production. They contain no funds,
credentials, RPC configuration, FFI or imported dependencies. The constructor refuses
nonlocal chain identity and zero timestamp. No deployment to a public chain is intended.

Two generated named properties require paused/stale operations to leave their counters
unchanged. Their cited source is the public entry point, while the actual checks live
in a modifier and nested internal helpers. Removing one check in an owned disposable
copy must fail only its corresponding generated property and preserve the other one.
The original source is the remediated variant and is restored/preserved exactly.

Uncalled external/virtual and bounded recursive functions are structural graph controls;
the external interface is never given an endpoint or executed. Tests retain unresolved
call relations rather than claiming unsupported dynamic dispatch is absent. All native
execution uses the existing offline toolchain with explicitly MOCK isolation and grants
no real-audit, qualification or release authority.

Native controls independently exercise renamed helpers and a Unicode comment with LF, CRLF
and mixed line endings in root and nested projects. Actual Forge removes CR before LF; the
explicit bounded source map retains both exact byte identities and compiler spans while
binding downstream locations to the original file. Original source/AST are not rewritten.
All eight controls run actual synthetic campaigns and reconstruct the exact plan in a fresh
process; eight additional mapped-source children reject omitted or forged map metadata.

Native coverage controls retain all14 compiler statements. Thirteen match exact debug spans;
Forge omits the modifier placeholder in every newline variant. The full-population producer
must reject that gap. Coverage build-info is not retained by this Forge command, so only
identical original pre/post inventories support the debug comparison. Neither limitation is
waived, and no qualified execution, complete statement coverage or real-audit credit follows.
